title: Zurich Tree Management: tree-anchored service requests and a city-wide location-ambiguity analysis
description: Research demonstrator (ASP.NET Core) for urban-tree service requests anchored to the tree in the City of Zürich open tree cadastre: resident reporting in four steps, public tracking without personal data, a staff desk, and privacy enforced at the API boundary. Includes the analysis code (81,403 trees, 59,330 addresses) comparing street-only, address-only and map-based intake and four map-selection rules under simulated touch error, and the accompanying paper. Independent academic work, not affiliated with the City of Zürich.
